title: Runtime failure telemetry orchestrator and error synthesis
creator: Marco Chen
description: Build a telemetry orchestration layer and a set of canonical artifacts that synthesize error signals across transport (HTTP/gRPC), serving runtime, and model outputs. The goal is to provide a single source-of-truth failure taxonomy, automated trace enrichment hooks, and a set of exploratory dashboards that let SREs and engineers rapidly slice by timeout, overload, model-internal errors, and protocol codes. This ticket covers: 1) trace hook spec and client/runtime instrumentation points for attaching failure facets (eg. kernel backpressure, batch wait time, kv-cache hit/miss); 2) metrics & logs pipeline changes to tag, normalize, and forward a standardized failure_reason label; 3) ETL and metric aggregation rules for new dashboard metrics (failure_rate_by_window, p99_tail_lat_by_error_class, overload_pressure_index); 4) a dashboard template and a drilldown flow that starts from service-level SLO breaches to specific GPU/worker traces and model responses; 5) cost/sampling policy and retention trade-offs for high-cardinality attributes. Emphasize backwards compatibility with existing SLO alerts and support for both hosted and dedicated deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Trace hook spec merged in runtime repo and published to Confluence
Metrics pipeline produces canonical metric 'redwood.failure_reason' with stable label set
Dashboard template in Grafana that supports pivoting by 'failure_reason', 'model_variant', 'region', and 'route'
SLO alerts updated to allow quick suppression when automated fallback policies kick in
Sampling policy implemented: 100% sampling for errors, 1% for success requests with high-cardinality tags, and burst sampling for overload windows
End-to-end test that injects synthetic timeout/overload/model-error traces and validates dashboard counts and links to traces
comments: 2026-03-01 Marco Chen: Kickoff — scoped initial work with Observability PM. Identified three primary failure classes to capture: transport, runtime, model. Agreed to reuse existing trace ids and add 'failure_reason' and 'failure_facet' tags to spans.

2026-03-03 Sophie Laurent: Prototype trace hook added to local runtime branch. Hook exposes event points: pre-dispatch, post-kernel, batch-queue-wait, model-deserialize. Need design review for tag cardinality concerns.

2026-03-04 Aisha Patel (PM): Reviewed prototype. Concern: adding model error codes could include user prompt content — must ensure strict PII redaction before forwarding logs. Asked to add log sanitizer step to pipeline.

2026-03-05 Marco Chen: Implemented pipeline normalization rules. Mapping table created to map HTTP/gRPC codes to our taxonomy (timeout, client_error, server_error, overload, model_error). Draft mapping: 504->timeout, 429->overload, 5xx->server_error, model-exec-error->model_error. Shared PR for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1124

2026-03-06 Security review note from Priya R.: Need KMS-backed key for exporting sensitive debug logs; require retention limits for dedicated customers. Marking 'security_review_required' for follow-up if we surface raw model outputs.

2026-03-08 Sophie Laurent: Dashboard wireframe pushed to Grafana repo. New panels: failure funnel by route, latency distribution heatmap by failure_reason, and worker pressure timeline. Link: https://grafana.redwood-internal/d/observability/failure-explorer

2026-03-09 Engineering review: Decided to implement enrichment only at the runtime edge to avoid double-counting in proxies. Also decided to cap cardinality of 'model_variant' and 'route' using an allowlist and hash-bucketing for unknown values.

2026-03-10 Marco Chen: Deployed ETL to staging. Initial smoke shows 'redwood.failure_reason' emitted for 100% of failed requests and for 1% of successes. Observed unexpected spike in 'overload' during synthetic load test — need to tune batch window logic.
2026-03-10 Sophie Laurent: Action — create follow-up tickets for batch-window tuning and KMS export gating. Assigned to ENG-198345 and ENG-198346 respectively.
decisions: Canonical label 'redwood.failure_reason' adopted across metrics and logs to unify dashboards and alerts
Sampling policy: 100% for error paths, adaptive burst sampling for overload signals, 1% for successes with heavy tags
Instrumentation limited to runtime edge to avoid proxy duplication; proxies will forward minimal tags only
Model outputs will never be forwarded raw; only normalized error codes and hashed model ids allowed unless explicit customer consent
